Both pathways involve the modulation of enzymes that ultimately affect Phosphodiesterase 6C, indicating a potential mechanism of action through different molecular targets. The scores from the two paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain.
